mods.name: Slightly Better Terrible Tools
mods.description: SBTT is an addon for Better Than Wolves CE 3.0.0 that makes early-game tools more comfortable, viable, intuitive, and interesting to use (without making them good).

releases.notes:
## What's New:

### Pointy Stick
- **Change**: Using it to harvest clay from clay ore blocks is now just a bit slower
  - Takes about a second longer compared to using a stone shovel, still drops only clay piles.

### Shovels (All Types)
- **Change**: Added exhaustion per use toward firming and packing
  - Packing causes exhaustion equivalent to the player using a hand crank
  - Firming causes exhasution equivalent to half that of using the hand crank

### Sharp Stone
- **Change**: The very rare chance of getting hemp seeds from using sharp stones to sparsen grass is now:
  - Weighted so that you are unlikely to get drops in close succession.
  - Gets more likely the more you sparsen, starting from 1/200 and decreasing the denominator until it's a coin flip.
  - Attempts are tracked per-player, and they save between death, exiting the game, etc.
  - The chance resets to 1/200 once the player gets a seed, and the process restarts.
  - This is meant to be a hint toward starting a hemp farm, not a viable strategy for getting hemp seeds.

### Stability
- **Fix**: Destroying clay blocks with your bare hands was causing the game to crash due to failure to verify non-null item stack.

---

mods.name: Slightly Better Terrible Tools
mods.description: SBTT is an addon for Better Than Wolves CE 3.0.0 that makes early-game tools more comfortable, viable, intuitive, and interesting to use (without making them good).

releases.notes:
## What's New:

### Major Rewrite
- Removed a lot of the funnel-and-check style programming logic in favor of **locality-of-behavior** for easier maintenance and readability.
- Should now work better with multiplayer by removing global, static, potentially-stale state.

### "No Wasted Uses" Removal (But GOOD NEWS!)
- It's now its own addon mod: [Prevent Wasted Uses](https://github.com/AbbyRead/Prevent_Wasted_Uses)
- Prevent Wasted Uses works well with SBTT or vanilla BTW, and it *should* work well with other addons as well.
- Download the latest version here: [Prevent Wasted Uses: Release Page](https://github.com/AbbyRead/Prevent_Wasted_Uses/releases/latest).

### Pointy Stick Enhancements
- **New feature**: Can now harvest clay piles from clay ore blocks, converting the block to loose dirt
- Loosen packed earth, making firm dirt equivalent in a 1:2 ratio (packed earth slab to full dirt block)

### Stone Shovel Improvements
- **Changed**: Now costs 2 durability to firm up loose dirt-like blocks (previously cost 1 durability).

### Clubs - New Block Conversion Mechanics
- **New feature**: Bone club can pack dirt/grass blocks into packed earth slabs (costs 4 durability)
- **New feature**: Bone club can pack earth downward to make a full packed earth block (costs 4 durability)
- Both wooden and bone clubs can firm up loose dirt-like blocks slowly (costs 2 durability)

### Higher-Level Tool Improvements
- **New feature**: Iron and better shovels can now firm-up and pack loose dirt (costs 2 and 4 durability still, respectively)
- Iron and diamond chisels continue to harvest whole ores (now explicitly documented as intended behavior)

### New Recipes
- Create regular dirt from loose dirt and slime balls (now with a sound effect on crafting!):
  - 1 Loose Dirt Block + 1 Slime Ball → 1 Dirt Block
  - 2 Loose Dirt Slabs + 1 Slime Ball → 1 Dirt Block
  - 1 Loose Dirt Slab + 1 Slime Ball → 1 Dirt Slab
  - 8 Dirt Piles + 1 Slime Ball → 1 Dirt Block (High-Efficiency Recipe)

## Summary

v1.1.0 implements the planned features from v1.0.2's roadmap, adding packed earth crafting via the bone club and expanding dirt-firming mechanics across more tools. The pointy stick gains clay harvesting capability, and the new slime ball recipes provide additional utility for an otherwise limited item.

releases.notes:
### Changes in v1.0.2
- Added recipes to make dirt from loose dirt and a slime ball
- Iron and diamond chisels now harvest whole ores
  - This was done to match their use as viable diamond-harvesters already.
  - It gives you a reason to use them up and hints at their existing gem-harvesting use.

**Intended for Next Release:**
- Tiered damage for shovel, chisel, and axe to make lesser-uses not as disincentivized.
- Create packed earth from dirt using iron shovel (and above) or bone club (inefficiently).

mods.name: Slightly Better Terrible Tools
mods.description: SBTT is an addon for Better Than Wolves CE 3.0.0 that makes early-game tools more comfortable, viable, intuitive, and interesting to use (without making them good).

releases.notes:
[SBTT-1.0.1.hotfix4.jar](https://github.com/BTW-Community/Slightly_Better_Terrible_Tools/releases/download/v1.0.1-hotfix4/SBTT-1.0.1.hotfix4.jar) is what I'm considering the first stable and indicative release prior to implementing changes some people may not prefer (tiered tool damage plans, earlier packed earth, et al.).

Changes in this version:

- Fixed tool damage calculation for several edge cases where tools act slowly but are better than nothing (block conversion, harvest quality, etc.).
- Removed unintended additional speed boost for cutting loose sparse grass (loose dirtlikes are boosted already).
- Nerfed the boost to sand and gravel harvest speed, as it feels kind of weird treating them as nicely as loose dirt/grass since they don't require any work from the start to get them in that state.  Relative speeds now: loose-dirt/grass > sand > gravel > firm-dirt/grass (fast to slow).

mods.name: Slightly Better Terrible Tools
mods.description: This addon increases the usability of the worst tools, slightly.

releases.notes:
[SBTT-1.0.0.jar](https://github.com/BTW-Community/Slightly_Better_Terrible_Tools/releases/download/v1.0.0/SBTT-1.0.0.jar) is the initial public release of Slightly Better Terrible Tools.

[Debug_Printouts-1.0.0.jar](https://github.com/BTW-Community/Slightly_Better_Terrible_Tools/releases/download/v1.0.0/Debug_Printouts-1.0.0.jar) can be used by itself or with SBTT if you'd like to compare speeds of block destruction/harvest.

[Superflat.Test.Area.zip](https://github.com/BTW-Community/Slightly_Better_Terrible_Tools/releases/download/v1.0.0/Superflat.Test.Area.zip) is also available with relevant blocks laid out and enough supplies to get by for a while.   You can use the chat commands "/gamemode survival" and "/gamemode creative" to switch between modes as needed.

## Features

### Tool Efficiency Improvements

**Less Painfully Slow**: The crappiest tools (including bare hands) have a speed boost where it makes sense.

**No Wasted Uses**: If a tool does not help, it will not be damaged on block-break.  This is primarily a convenience
feature to prevent tedious item swapping, secondarily to telegraph purpose(s) of an item.

**Bare Hands and Non-Tools**:
- Slight speed boost on log harvesting

**Wooden Chisel (Pointy Stick)**
- Slight speed boost on log and stone harvesting
- Speed boost on prying up loose cobblestone/brick blocks
- Able to loosen a single block of dirt or sparse grass
- 2 extra uses to add value and incentivize experimentation

**Stone Chisel (Sharp Stone)**
- Slight speed boost on log and stone harvesting
- Shatters ice, glass, and other breakables faster
- Cuts grass in stages with a VERY low chance for hemp seeds
- Chips through the final stages of rough stone at half speed (as opposed to zero boost)

**Changes to Iron & Diamond Chisel (Contextually-Necessary)**
- Scaled efficiency improvements on:
    - Loose masonry blocks
    - Solid stone-like blocks
    - Shatterable blocks
    - Web blocks

**Stone Shovel**
- No longer disturbs neighboring dirt/grass blocks when digging.
- Can firm up loose dirt-like blocks instantly by right-clicking (costs 1 durability).
- 50% more durability (encourages digging beyond just clay)
- 50% faster on appropriate materials (improved to incentivize use in context)

**Clubs (Wooden & Bone)**
- Can firm up loose dirt-like blocks SLOWLY (costs 2 durability)

### Block Changes

**Loose Ground Digs Easier**: Loose dirt, loose grass, sand, and gravel are faster to dig up in general.

**Restored Grass Block Disturbance**
- If a dirt block below grass is destroyed by an improper tool (e.g., bare hands), the grass turns to loose dirt and falls.
- It was removed from the standard game because we didn't have enough options to avoid it.
- It is an interesting feature, and now it's not as annoying!
- Remember, you can loosen the dirt below with a pointy stick, and stone shovels no longer disturb.

### Unrelated Fixes

- Modifies the Better Than Wolves title logo to fix the kerning.
